_description: Block user prompts containing personal data (PII). Fires on every user message before it reaches Claude. Exit code 2 cancels the submission. Covers: AVS/AHV, IBAN, credit card, Swiss phone, e-mail, CHE company ID, passport/ID mentions, dates of birth, postal addresses, long numeric IDs.
_install: 2. Merge the 'hooks.UserPromptSubmit' block below into your .claude/settings.json
3. Adjust the path in 'command' to match where you placed pii_check.py
_policy: TCS Directive SI-04 — Usage des outils IA / LPD / RGPD
